activity_summary: Back at the inn, nobody sang. You left the fifth unnamed on paper and left Sly for a later morning. Bryan would not tell the chair's laugh a second time. Heminges still had no sum, and he still would not write the three nights into the book by starlight. Kemp's button story stayed held for the inn down the river. The two cloaks stayed for morning. You took the middle of the bed you share with Heminges and Bryan.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a path-side lesson, took the middle of the bed, and went in.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept the green from becoming a second hall, and took Nick as far as the stair.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Walked without singing, and said good night.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Left the bow as it was, and stopped looking.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Kept the chair's laugh from becoming a wage, and claimed his side of the bed.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Entered nothing, and kept the cloaks for morning.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Held the story, and said this inn did not qualify.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Already up. Not praised into waiting for another break.

entities.name: Queen Elizabeth
entities.context: Not on the green. Her laugh was not told a second time.

facets.activity: Came back to the inn and took the middle of the bed

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: This is not that inn. A green does not qualify.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: I am not writing three nights into a book by starlight.

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: A second telling is how kindly becomes a wage, and there is no wage.
